name: Crash
note: Multiplier climbs until it crashes; cash out before it does.
steps: Place a bet before the round starts.
Cash out any time before it crashes to lock in that multiplier.
tips: Set an auto-cashout target to remove reaction-time risk.
The house edge is fixed regardless of when you cash out.

name: Plinko
note: Ball drops through pegs into multiplier slots; risk setting changes the payout table.
steps: Choose a risk level (low/medium/high) and row count.
Payout is read off the slot it lands in.
tips: Higher risk widens the payout spread but doesn't change the long-run edge much.
More rows increase variance, not RTP.
